name: ai-crop-recommendation-system
description: AI Crop Recommendation System built with React.js, Express.js, and MongoDB

scripts.install:all: npm --prefix backend install && npm --prefix frontend install
scripts.build: npm --prefix backend install && npm --prefix frontend install && npm --prefix frontend run build
scripts.dev: node -e "const { spawn } = require('child_process'); spawn('npm', ['run', 'server'], { stdio: 'inherit', shell: true }); spawn('npm', ['run', 'client'], { stdio: 'inherit', shell: true });"
